verdict.rationale: Bento's own FAQ says cost per run is visible out of the box, which partly covers per-request cost. The CLI docs confirm there is a dashboard with analytics that can also be pulled from the terminal. Missing for 10: token usage metrics, cost or token breakdown by model, aggregation over time periods in dashboards, detailed dashboard documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: you see cost per run, tool failure rates, drift over prompt versions, and regressions across deploys out of the box.
Anything you can do in the dashboard, you can do from your terminal, a script, or CI: triage issues, read runs, inspect signals, pull analytics.
